## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Sleeper Channels describes empirical evaluation as follow-on work, rather than presenting a Hermes exploit benchmark. (low confidence) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13471
- [statement] Folkfox's 6 October 2026 review says it checked documentation rather than testing every feature. (low confidence) — https://folkfox.com/hermes-agent-review-twenty-promises-checked/
- [statement] The outer-loop error handler stops immediately for interpreter-shutdown errors rather than retrying. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/agent/turn_loop_errors.py
- [statement] The memory guide checks character capacity on the final result of an operations batch rather than each intermediate removal or addition. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/website/docs/user-guide/features/memory.md
- [statement] The pinned security policy requires authorization rechecking rather than treating a session ID as an authorization boundary. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/SECURITY.md
- [statement] The gateway guide says a started admission whose owner dies becomes unknown and pauses its session FIFO instead of being automatically replayed. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/website/docs/developer-guide/gateway-internals.md · keywords: Hermes Agent · also: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/hermes_state_runtime.py
- [statement] PAST-Bench characterizes its mechanism-evidence score as consistency with an expected persistence pathway rather than proof of causal necessity. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://arxiv.org/html/2608.04003v1
- [statement] For MiniMax-M2.7 in PAST-Bench, Hermes+ uses 31,859 tokens per episode versus Hermes’ 12,615, while mean wall time is 77.4 seconds versus 70.5 seconds. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://arxiv.org/html/2608.04003v1
- [statement] At the pinned revision, claim_session_input refuses a FIFO head that differs from the admission validated during preclaim checks. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/hermes_state_runtime.py · keywords: Hermes Agent · also: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/69f73ec5f11f5a945cc864f29c4e2ad2307eaec3/gateway/session_authority.py
